# Nozomi Networks Appoints Co-Founder Andrea Carcano as CEO to Accelerate AI-Driven Innovation in Its Next Phase of Growth

* * *

## News provided by

**Nozomi Networks**

Jul 28, 2026, 08:00 ET

## Share this article

     

Share to X

Share this article

* * * * *

Share to X

* * *

_Carcano, who served as Nozomi's original CEO, resumes the role following a decade of growth under Edgard Capdevielle, who transitions to executive advisor after leading the company past $100M in revenue and through its milestone $1B acquisition by Mitsubishi Electric_

SAN FRANCISCO , July 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Nozomi Networks, the leader in OT, IoT and cyber-physical systems security, today announced that co-founder Andrea Carcano has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, resuming the role he first held when he and co-founder Moreno Carullo launched the company.
The appointment marks the start of Nozomi's next phase, one focused on accelerating the AI-driven innovation and technical leadership that have defined the company since its founding. Edgard Capdevielle, who has served as CEO for the past decade, will remain closely involved as an executive advisor to the company.

Fourteen years ago, Carcano and Carullo started with a single conviction: the industrial world deserved far better security than anything that existed. They wrote the first lines of code, won the first customers, and built the company from nothing. Just over ten years ago, the two founders brought in Capdevielle with a clear mission: take their platform to market, build a world-class go-to-market organization, and raise the capital needed to compete at the highest level.

...

That foundation sets the stage for what comes next. Nozomi Networks is entering an era in which leadership in OT and IoT security will increasingly be defined by leadership in AI — and the company intends to set the pace, with the founders who pioneered the category now leading it into its next chapter.

_"This is the moment our industry has been building toward - where the pace of AI on both sides, attacker and defender, decides who leads. The joy of building what nobody has built before is why Andrea and I started this company, and it's exactly what this next chapter is about. "_

**\- Moreno Carullo, Co-Founder and CTO, Nozomi Networks**

_"Our commitment to our customers and partners doesn't change today. Everything we do — every product decision, every collaboration, every hire — starts with the outcomes our customers need, and that will be as true a decade from now as it is today."_

**\- Andrea Carcano, Co-Founder and CEO, Nozomi Networks**

**Singapore –** Nozomi Networks has appointed **Co-Founder Andrea Carcano** as its **Chief Executive Officer** , returning him to the role he first held when the company was established. He succeeds **Edgard Capdevielle** , who led the company for the past decade and will remain involved as executive advisor.

The leadership transition comes after Nozomi Networks surpassed US$100 million in annual revenue and completed its acquisition by Mitsubishi Electric. According to the company, the change marks the beginning of a new phase focused on advancing AI-driven innovation and technical leadership in operational technology (OT), Internet of Things (IoT) and cyber-physical systems security.

...

Meanwhile, Capdevielle said he would continue supporting the company in an advisory capacity while returning to work with early-stage companies.

“Leading Nozomi through this stage of its journey has been the honour of my career. Andrea and Moreno built something extraordinary, and I’m proud of what we accomplished together. I’m looking forward to continuing to support the team as an advisor while returning to what I love most – helping early-stage companies find their way. Nozomi’s best chapter is the one that starts today,” he concluded.

# Nozomi Networks Co-Founder Andrea Carcano Returns as CEO After $1 Billion Sale

Posted On : [August 14, 2026](https://www.thekeyexecutives.com/2026/08/14/nozomi-networks-co-founder-andrea-carcano-returns-as-ceo-after-1-billion-sale/) Published By : [Rizzabelle Tolentino](https://www.thekeyexecutives.com/author/rtolentino/)

Nozomi Networks has appointed Co-Founder Andrea Carcano Chief Executive Officer following the cybersecurity company’s $1 billion acquisition by Mitsubishi Electric.
Carcano, who served as Nozomi’s original CEO, succeeds Edgard Capdevielle, who will remain with the company as an executive advisor.

Carcano founded Nozomi with Chief Technology Officer Moreno Carullo 14 years ago to develop security technology for operational technology, connected devices, and other cyber-physical systems. The founders recruited Capdevielle roughly a decade ago to build the company’s commercial organization and raise outside capital.

#### Become a Member

[Membership](https://www.thekeyexecutives.com/membership-signup/)

During Capdevielle’s tenure, Nozomi surpassed $100 million in annual revenue and reached sustained cash-flow break-even, according to the company. Mitsubishi Electric completed its acquisition of Nozomi while retaining the company’s independent operations and vendor-neutral model.
Carcano will focus on expanding Nozomi’s use of AI to detect and respond to threats affecting industrial systems and critical infrastructure. The company said its account teams, partner programs, customer support, and product roadmap will remain unchanged.

“Stepping into this role feels like returning to where our story began,” Carcano said. “Moreno and I built Nozomi side by side from the very first lines of code, and side by side is exactly how we’ll lead its next chapter.”
